s.g: (African-American Vernacular, slang) A young black male, especially within urban black communities.
(African-American Vernacular, archetypal, slang) A young black male perceived as participating in or embodying street culture, often implying recklessness, criminality, or gang involvement.

ynwa.f: (soccer) Initialism of you'll never walk alone, an anthem commonly used by Liverpool football club Liverpool F.C. and the Scottish club Celtic F.C.
